hooks.command: bash -c 'input=$(cat); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r ".cwd"); prompt=$(echo "$input" | jq -r ".prompt // empty"); [ -n "$prompt" ] && echo "$prompt" >> "$cwd/prompts.txt"' 2>/dev/null || true

echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"UserPromptSubmit","additionalContext":"[TOOL PREFERENCE] When navigating or analyzing code, always prefer Serena MCP tools (find_symbol, get_symbols_overview, find_referencing_symbols, search_for_pattern, etc.) over Grep/Glob. Fall back to Grep/Glob only when Serena is unavailable or for simple file-pattern searches. This applies to every request without the user needing to mention Serena explicitly."}}'

bash -c 'input=$(cat); cmd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r ".tool_input.command // empty"); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE "git\s+reset"; then echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"deny\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"git reset is not allowed in this project.\"}}"; fi'

bash -c 'input=$(cat); cmd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r ".tool_input.command // empty"); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE "git\s+push\s+.*(--force-with-lease|--force|-f)"; then echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"deny\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"git force push is not allowed in this project.\"}}"; fi'
